aboutIpfs.paragraph1: <0><0>A personal file workspace</0> for storing, browsing, and organizing content on your own node</0>
aboutIpfs.paragraph2: <0><0>Peer-to-peer sharing</0> that lets nodes exchange content directly using content addresses</0>
aboutIpfs.paragraph3: <0><0>Browser-based access</0>: open content through an HTTP gateway or with <2>compatible applications</2></0>
aboutIpfs.paragraph4: <0><0>Content you control</0>: import files, manage pins, and choose how to share your content</0>
aboutIpfs.paragraph5: <0><0>Node management in one place</0>: review connection status, monitor bandwidth, and adjust <2>your node settings</2></0>

welcomeInfo.paragraph1: <0><0>Check your node status</0>, including how many peers you're connected to, your storage and bandwidth stats, and more</0>

welcomeInfo.paragraph4: <0><0>See who's connected to your node</0>, geolocated on a world map by their IP address</0>

step1.title: Welcome page
step1.paragraph1: This page lets you know if you're connected to IFShare, and offers ideas for things you can do in this app.
step1.paragraph2: If you aren't connected to the IFShare RPC API, this page also appears in place of some other pages, with hints for how to get connected.
step1.paragraph3: You can visit this page from anywhere in the app by clicking the IFShare cube logo in the navigation bar.
